dlls.name: USER32.dll
dlls.relevance: window placement, focus, keyboard state, raw input, window enumeration

implication: The native runtime is a Win32 window that consumes standard Windows keyboard state. A browser relay can drive the game's two configured keyboard pads with keybd_event after focusing the game window; no injected DLL or virtual gamepad driver is required.
limitations: Imports do not prove an import is bound or reachable at runtime.
The release build has the TCP debug server compiled out; the relay therefore uses the same USER32 input path as the game.
Built-in netplay is compiled out of this release; it returns netplay start failed (-1). The project uses the game's real 2-player split-screen mode instead.
